subtitle: Tap a reminder to change its time.
infoText: 💡 These notifications fire every day at the chosen time, even if the app is closed.

morning.title: ☀️ New day, new start
morning.body: Today, you can do better than yesterday. Log your cigarettes.

afternoon.title: 🚬 How's it going today?
afternoon.body: Remember to log your cigarettes. Every number counts.

evening.title: 📊 Your day's summary
evening.body: How many did you smoke today? Log it before you sleep.

encouragement.title: 💪 Hanging in there?
encouragement.body: A quick reminder to log your cigarettes.

extra.title: ⏰ Extra reminder
extra.body: Take 10 seconds to log your cigarettes.

night.title: 🌙 End of day
night.body: Last chance to log today's consumption.
